title: Start From the SOP Library
text: Select + New SOP to start a procedure. Existing procedures use Edit SOP or View SOP.

title: Name the Procedure
text: Enter an Equipment or Process — Task title. Select the responsible team and enter an effective date when applicable.

title: Choose Searchable Tags
text: Open Choose Tags and select relevant topics. Tags help operators find procedures in the library.

title: Add Context and Preparation
text: Use Purpose for the goal, Background for useful context, and separate fields for equipment, safety, security, and notes. Leave unused fields empty.

title: Organize Sections and Steps
text: Name the phase, then add a numbered step. Write one main action per step. The creator handles numbering.

title: Add Supporting Substeps
text: Use Add Substep for smaller actions belonging to the parent task. Enter starts the next item; Shift+Enter adds a line break.

title: Use a Table for Repeated Information
text: Select Add Table. Edit headings and cells directly, and use the row and column controls as needed.

title: Attach a Photo and Caption
text: Use Add Photo on the relevant step. Add a caption explaining what the image shows. Multiple photos are arranged automatically.

title: Edit Through the Live Preview
text: Click highlighted text in Live Preview to jump to its entry field. Drag the center divider to resize; use the pop-out icon for a separate window.

title: Record Creation, Revisions, and Reviews
text: Choose the history entry type, date, and person. Creation starts with SOP Created. Record an approver only after approval occurs.

title: Save the SOP
text: Select Save SOP to store the document in the library. A browser draft is a recovery copy, not a saved library SOP.

title: View or Edit the Saved Procedure
text: Use View SOP for the saved read-only document and Print / Save PDF. Use the pencil to edit. This walkthrough saved only to isolated training storage.
